title: ID0409800-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P8 170000834]Outlet 2 state alters from Available to Unavailable multiple times
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:Outlet 2 state alters from Available to Unavailable multiple times
Root cause: MCB or RCD Tripped or Loose connection of Status feedback of FB1 or MCB5  to PLC
Solution: Need to check hardware connection.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: no
Warranty Status: Expired on 11/08/2024

Note:
As checked in logs the AC outlet state is getting change very frequently from Available to Not available
Reason: RCB( FB1) or MCB (FC5)
Work Need to be done at Site:
1) Please follow all safety rules
2) Turn of the charger & check if RCD or MCB is tripped or it's in On Condition
3) IF found in On Condition check the continuity using multimeter as per SLD market in Green
4) If Found Tripped, turn on RCB( FB1) & or  MCB (FC5) , Turn On the charger & Check if error is still appearing or Not.
Please carry Spare RCD or MCB if required
5) Charger In Off Condition, Also check the tightness of wire as per SLD
Kindly pick up the case using "

" option in the queue or manually using the "

" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.

unified service process
